S01.evidence: The joint pdf is estimated on historical training SCADA records using bivariate KDE; L = MSE + lambda*D_JS(P_pred || P_prior); Table 4 compares lambda>0 vs lambda=0.
S01.notes: D1: KDE fitted from historical SCADA, frozen pre-training -> historical-static. D2: JS divergence as loss regularizer -> training-loss. D3: historical sliding-window only -> none. D5: pure constraint on/off (lambda=0 baseline).

S02.evidence: Target pdf derived from historical SCADA via KDE; L = MSE + alpha*D_JS(P_pred||P_target); evaluates PCT with vs without physical loss.
S02.notes: D1: target distribution from historical SCADA KDE -> historical-static. D2: divergence penalty in loss -> training-loss. D4: no accessible code repo disclosed in provided source text -> not-found. D5: with/without physical loss = constraint on/off.

S03.evidence: Theoretical power curve based on Betz-aerodynamic principles defines envelopes; samples violating envelope re-projected; forecast model trained on augmented corpus.
S03.notes: D1: Betz aerodynamic envelope is analytic/nameplate -> intrinsic. D2: constraint used to synthesize/augment training data -> data-generation. D5: w/o Generative Augmentation is whole-module removal -> module-ablation.

S04.evidence: R_phys = max(0,P-P_rated)+max(0,-P); L adds beta*sum R_phys; inputs comprise future NWP fields; Table 4 (beta>0 vs 0), Table 5 (dual vs single stream).
S04.notes: D1: rated capacity is nameplate constant -> intrinsic. D2: penalty in loss -> training-loss. D3: requires future NWP -> forecast-input. D5: both constraint on/off (Table 4) and module (Table 5).

S07.evidence: Physical conversion stream computes P_aero = 1/2 rho A Cp v_NWP^3 from future NWP; fused with token embeddings in self-attention; Table 5 NCF vs w/o Physics Branch.
S07.notes: D1: aerodynamic power equation analytic -> intrinsic. D2: physics branch hard-wired into backbone -> inference-architecture. D3: needs future NWP wind -> forecast-input. D5: w/o Physics Branch = module-ablation.

S09.evidence: Reward includes indicator penalties for rated capacity P_cap and ramp rate dP_max; Table 3 gamma>0 vs gamma=0 (pure pinball baseline).
S09.notes: D1: rated capacity/ramp limits are nameplate/physical constants -> intrinsic. D2: penalty in reward (training objective) -> training-loss. D3: no future forecast input stated -> none. D5: gamma on/off = constraint on/off.

S10.evidence: J dw/dt = Ta - Tg; L = L_evidential + lambda_ode ||J dw/dt - (Ta-Tg)||^2; Table 4 lambda_ode=0 vs >0.
S10.notes: D1: rotor rotational ODE is analytic physics -> intrinsic. D2: ODE residual added to loss -> training-loss. D4: GitHub repo provided but not code-verified -> unverified. D5: lambda_ode on/off = constraint on/off.

S11.notes: D1: Navier-Stokes PDE is analytic -> intrinsic. D2: PDE residual in loss -> training-loss. D3: no future input stated -> none. D5: with/without PDE = constraint on/off.

S12.notes: D1: power curve (cut-in/rated/cut-out) analytic -> intrinsic. D2: hard-coded basis functions in forward blocks -> inference-architecture. D5: vs standard NBeatsx lacking physical blocks = module-ablation.
